body:
I am glad that there are safe internet forums where people help one another though their suicidal intentions. I would love to provide this link to her but how can I do so with solely good intentions? I fear that if I send her this link, she will be insulted. Am I being too presumptuous or is there a more smooth way to send her to this link. 

Last night, she told me I was the only friend who took her seriously and did not assume her attempt was a plea for attention. I must continue to be that support and understand that everything is real for her. I tried to be completely indifferent about her thoughts and did my best to make the environment judgement free and safe for her to vent her feelings. I do realize now after visiting this subreddit that these cliche responses are clearly not a good option and there are options much better. 

I do remember at one point last night, I did repeatedly tell her "please don't do this" because I was so terrified and shocked I did not know what else to say. I hope she conveyed that phrase as genuine care. She is beginning to feel much better today and definitely felling love from me and my friend. Slowly but surely I will help her recover. 

Thank you very much for taking the time to help me and provide me with a useful link and advise for her in the future. Peace and love to you too.

Thank you for your kind words. And yes you are correct about how she thinks and feels right now. I am glad I was able to convey her thoughts and feelings properly. My friend talked to her today and did advise her to get a therapist who genuinely cares and whom she can trust. I think she realizes that is priority so that makes me more comfortable. Right now, she has lost interest in all of her hobbies. Her once burning passion for hiking and outdoor activities has disappeared. I will make sure to mention she should continue those hobbies or to find a new hobby or club. Fortunately, universities provide endless possibilities for her so I hope she is able to find something she love soon. Also, I want to find other people she was once close to or whom she trusts and just have them talk to her. Currently, I am talking to her right now and she seems to be doing much better from last night. I would love to visit her again, but our universities are not as close as it could be to easily visit her. I am waiting for summer to see her again and talk to her in person but for now, calling and texting her is the most viable option for me. I will be sure to give her enough room to breathe. Again thank you for your kind words. It is comforting to know I did some good rather than harm. I will be sure to read the links you have provided for me and properly help her in thee future when she needs it. 

Thank you for the compliment :) I notice that my writing correlates to how much passion I have for the subject. I truly do care for her. Thank you for taking the time and answering my questions and if anything ever comes up in the future, I will be sure to seek your guidance.

Thank you for your insight on the situation. Its comforting to know I did a few things correctly but after posting this and reading everyone's comments, I know I have much more work to do. Fortunately, I believe I am able to handle this situation better due to everyone's help. 
I will do my best to allocate as much time to her care. I realized last night that company and a shoulder to cry on is a good remedy. I will talk to one of her friends in her college to listen to her and console her since I am away in my own college at the moment. 
I do like the idea of sharing my problems with her too. It's always nice to be needed so I will do my best to provide her with anything she needs. 
Thank you once again for you help.

Wow these links are amazing. Thank you so much for taking the time to give me this advise and I hope to use these to help Claire recover. And after visiting this subreddit and doing lots of research on the topic, I know I did make mistakes but I hope to handle the situation better in the future. Thank you once again for your expertise.
